Talk to our team and schedule a meeting with the best interior designers in Chennai to discuss your requirements and aspirations.
You can have a detailed conversation with interior decorators in Chennai about the dimensions of your home, your lifestyle, needs, and wants, along with an estimated quote.
Pay a 10% retainer and watch our team develop 3D rendered drawings of your vision. We will also provide a final quote for the cost of the undertaking.
Make an advance payment source necessary materials and commence the project.
Our expert engineers and interior designers in Chennai will coordinate and commence on-site execution.
When nearing completion, and after inspection of the on-going project, make a payment of 45% of the order value.
Our site engineers and experts will complete the project and hand over the cleaned and cleared site back to you.
Once the project is completed and you are satisfied with the end result, pay the balance of 5%.

Environmentally Sustainable Interior Design

Above everything, the health and well-being of the residents of a home is paramount. Our sustainable approach to interior design will exponentially enhance the quality of life of our patrons. We think beyond just design to provide our clients a holistic living experience.
An eco-friendly home can also be achieved by reusing materials as much as possible. By doing this the impact on the environment will be very low.
Reclaimed Wood: Old wood can be refinished & cut to make new wood flooring, kitchen cabinets, and cladding.

An eco-friendly home can also be achieved by reusing materials as much as possible. By doing this the impact on the environment will be very low. Reclaimed Wood: Old wood can be refinished & cut to make new wood flooring, kitchen cabinets, and cladding.
To reduce the impact on the environment, we try to reuse our materials as much as possible.
Glass: By refinishing old wood, we can cut it to make flooring, kitchen cabinets and cladding.
Walls & Ceilings: In our homes, we use water-based paints, recycled glass, ceramic tiles, earth-based natural clay paste, and wall covers made from plant fibers.
Flooring: ReclaimedSome of popular materials include reclaimed wood, natural stone, and flooring from renewable materials like cork, rubber and bamboo.
Window Treatment: We have window treatments that are made from 100% renewable materials like bamboo or fabric blinds, and natural grass like flax.

Sustainable Fabrics: As much as possible, we use eco-friendly fabrics. The plant fabrics are organic linen, cotton, bamboo, soy fiber and bark cloth, and the animal fabrics are wool, silk and cashmere.

Making Home Interiors Easy, From Design to Delivery
Simple steps to the perfect home.
Step One – Consultation & Visualisation

All home interior designers in Chennai know that it takes a variety of small building blocks to make a dream home. At Vibrant Spaces, we get down to the heart of the matter and simulate the home by understanding your vision for the space.
Step Two – Core & Shell Designing
The first step in designing a home is bringing together architecture and interiors. We bridge the gap between the two, and establish the canvas for the next phase.
Step Three – Fitouts & Furniture

Perfection is in the details, and the details lie in everything from the handles on your doors, to the sofa in your living room. We also create or recreate bespoke furniture to make the space truly your own.
Step Four – Styling & Decor

Be it mid-century modern or bohemian chic, we’ll style your home the way you like it. As the best home interior designers in Chennai, we understand your design aesthetic, know exactly how to find it, and where to put it!

Mrs. Varsha came to us with a clear vision of what she wanted: a minimal home that served as the perfect backdrop for her vibrant family. As the founder of a luxury perfumery, a homemaker, a mother of twins, and a doting daughter, Mrs. Varsha had her priorities straight. The design had to be simple, efficient, safe, and functional. It was a kind of a challenge that our team loves to take on. And we take great pride in what we’ve accomplished for the inspiring momtrepreneur. This premium penthouse, with a private garden, is part of a prominent high-rise apartment complex in Alwarpet. The spirit of Chennai flows in from every direction, yet the house provides a comfortable distance from it all. This feature gives the property a sense of stillness amidst the metropolitan bustle, which we reflected in the choice of colours throughout the house. It was going to be where their kids would grow up. It was going to be a space for the couple’s parents. It was going to be their source of inspiration, calm, and recreation. So, we ensured the house had a space carved out for all of their needs. The house radiates life with the custom-made bar cabinet, the elaborate walk-in closet, the imaginative bedroom for the kids, and the sublime private garden. Although every part of the house carries intricate details for the keen eye, they were designed to blend with the subdued elegance of the entire space — a decision made in accordance with the client’s vision. This project was a thoroughly delightful endeavour. I’d like to thank Mrs. Varsha and her family for trusting us with their beautiful home, and more importantly, for trusting us with their vision. Watch Less Is More to see how we brought it to life. Read More
